bing.title: 夕阳下的孤峰，鲍威尔湖脸峡谷，犹他州，美国
bing.headline: 夕阳下的孤峰，鲍威尔湖脸峡谷，犹他州，美国
bing.subtitle: 灰金交织的峡谷
bing.description:
脸峡谷隐于古老的砂岩地貌之中，是美国犹他州南部鲍威尔湖沿岸96座峡谷之一。许多峡谷远离公路，若非1963年修建格伦峡谷大坝形成的湖水淹入，此前很难抵达。湖水沿溪流和峡谷向上游延伸约186英里（约300公里），你可以乘船、划皮划艇或驾驶摩托艇探索。
鲍威尔湖历时17年才蓄至最高水位，是美国第二大人工湖。湛蓝的湖水与四周的砂岩峭壁相映成趣，也让它跻身风景最美的湖泊之列。要欣赏这片宁静的落日景色，或许得划船前来，但旅程本身就是冒险。如果正午抵达，脸峡谷的高耸崖壁还能帮你躲避沙漠烈日。

apod.title: Sh2-188：虾状星云
apod.description:
虾状星云内部的涡旋是由什么造成的？很可能是它的高速运动。
可以确定的是，Sh2-188是夜空中最大的行星状星云 之一，其角直径约为月球直径的一半。
此外，这颗类似太阳的恒星抛出外层大气后留下的白矮星核心，正以异常高速在星际空间中运动，形成了一个弓形震波，在左上方最为明显，形态类似于船只劈波斩浪。
尽管整体偏暗，但虾状星云运动前缘也会因压缩使气体增亮而发光。
这张精选影像以后院望远镜采集
氢、硫与氧的辐射光，
拍摄地在波兰的克拉科夫
，然后经过数位处理，以尽可能还原星云的真实色彩。
apod.explanation_en: What causes the swirl in the Shrimp Nebula? Its high speed is likely. What is sure is that Sh2-188 is one of the larger planetary nebulas on the night sky, by angular size, spanning about half the diameter of the Moon. Moreover, the white-dwarf core -- leftover from the Sun -like star that shed its outer atmosphere -- is moving unusually fast through interstellar space, creating a bow shock most visible on the upper left that is similar to a boat plowing through water. Although faint, the Shrimp Nebula glows also by compressing and brightening gas on its leading edge. The featured image was taken in the light of hydrogen, sulfur, and oxygen by a backyard telescope in Krakow, Poland and then digitally adjusted to approximate the nebula 's true colors. wikipedia.title: Sandy Hook Aerial 1 (11022025)
wikipedia.description: Aerial view of Sandy Hook , the barrier spit at the northern end of the Jersey Shore in Middletown Township, Monmouth County, New Jersey, looking north from above its southern end on 2 November 2025. Sandy Hook Bay, with its sand spits and shoals, is on the left and the Atlantic Ocean on the right; the beach parking areas of the Sandy Hook Unit of Gateway National Recreation Area line the ocean side, Fort Hancock lies near the tip, and the skyline of New York City is on the horizon. Photographed from a drone (DJI Mavic 4 Pro).
